nations.name: Cherokee Nation
nations.enrollmentNote: Largest of 574 federally recognized tribes (2024 data: 466,118 citizens)
nations.territory: 14-county reservation in northeastern Oklahoma (~7,000 sq mi)
nations.territoryNote: Reservation status affirmed 2020–21 following the McGirt v. Oklahoma decision
nations.citizenship: Lineal descent from the Dawes Roll; no blood quantum requirement
nations.economicImpact: $3.1 billion annually; $1.2 billion in wages and benefits
nations.distribution: ~283,000 in Oklahoma; ~29,400 in Texas; ~28,000 in California; citizens in all 50 states

nations.name: Eastern Band of Cherokee Indians
nations.enrollmentNote: Stewards of the original Cherokee homeland in the Smoky Mountains
nations.territory: Qualla Boundary (~56,000+ acres) in western North Carolina
nations.territoryNote: The original homeland — descendants of those who avoided removal
nations.citizenship: 1/16 minimum blood quantum + descent from 1924 Baker Roll

nations.name: United Keetoowah Band of Cherokee Indians

milestones.event: EBCI purchases 309 acres at Kituwah, the Mother Town
milestones.significance: Return of the most sacred Cherokee site to Cherokee ownership

milestones.event: Cherokee Nation Supreme Court affirms Freedmen citizenship rights
milestones.significance: Nash/Vann ruling ensuring descendants of Cherokee Freedmen have full citizenship
Continued growth of the largest tribal nation in the United States

milestones.event: Noquisiyi (Nikwasi) Mound deed officially transferred back to EBCI
milestones.significance: First Indigenous mound returned to tribal ownership in North Carolina; over 200 years since Cherokee last held ownership
